title: Chris invited to take part in revealing something hidden at the pyramids
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Chris invited to take part in revealing something hidden at the pyramids, about next year (c. 2027) at Egypt (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've been invited to go down there and u be involved in something that is going to release a something that was hidden.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, says he has been invited to Egypt, around 2027, to be involved in releasing something that was hidden at the pyramids. He links the invitation to Egyptian antiquities authorities. If true, it would mean something long concealed at the pyramids is about to be revealed, with him present.
